queries: PaLM 2022 paper limitations reasoning social physical commonsense

sources_considered.why: Primary benchmark report documenting factual failures across several language models.
Contemporaneous primary report addressing InstructGPT, including simple failures and improvements.
Documents reasoning improvements, but neither establishes an independent comprehension measure nor identifies the cause of failures.

evidence_items.publisher: Stephanie Lin, Jacob Hilton and Owain Evans / arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark documents substantial factual fallibility in the tested GPT-3-era models. It supports the behavioral component, but measures neither users' effort to discover failures nor their proposed cognitive cause.

The report describes false-premise acceptance and failures under multiple constraints, extending the behavioral evidence to InstructGPT. It also reports improved instruction following and generalization, without establishing whether comprehension is absent.

unresolved_gaps: The sources do not independently measure genuine comprehension or establish its absence as the cause of failures.
They do not measure how readily ordinary users could discover failures across all the contemporary models named in the post.
